recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片中同一視野就有四顆大型巨核細胞，其中幾顆核呈圓形或少分葉、胞質較嗜鹼性（較年輕的巨核細胞），背景紅血球與顆粒球前驅細胞活躍，符合化療後恢復期的巨核細胞增生（megakaryocytic hyperplasia）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with four megakaryocytes in a single high-power field
Megakaryocytes vary in maturity: one large with a multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, others with round to minimally lobated nuclei and more basophilic cytoplasm (young forms)
Active erythropoiesis with numerous polychromatophilic and orthochromatic erythroblasts
Maturing granulocytic precursors and scattered lymphocytes; no blast excess evident
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with increased megakaryocytes, including a mature form with a lobulated nucleus and several younger forms with round to minimally lobated nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors are abundant and show orderly maturation, and granulocytic precursors mature through to segmented forms without an evident increase in blasts. The younger megakaryocytes are large rather than micromegakaryocytes. In a patient recovering from chemotherapy, findings are consistent with regenerative megakaryocytic (and erythroid) hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes are small or micromegakaryocytes with hypolobated or widely separated round lobes, usually with dysplasia in other lineages and in the absence of recent chemotherapy.
AMKL shows increased megakaryoblasts (at least 20% blasts) with high N:C ratio and cytoplasmic blebs rather than maturing megakaryocytes.
MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated with clustering in biopsy, persisting with thrombocytosis and driver mutations rather than transient post-chemotherapy recovery.
ITP also shows increased megakaryocytes but in the setting of isolated peripheral thrombocytopenia rather than panmyeloid regeneration after therapy.
